title: Receiving Christ
definition: Receiving Christ is the faith-response of welcoming, trusting, and resting in Jesus as Savior and Lord.
summary: Receiving Christ means personally embracing Jesus as Savior, Lord, and the gift of God offered in the Gospel.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives the right to become children of God to those who receive and believe in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Receiving Christ is the personal response of faith to the person and work of Jesus. It is not receiving an idea while refusing the Savior, nor claiming forgiveness while rejecting His lordship. This doctrine stresses that salvation is relational: the sinner receives Christ Himself, with all the mercy, righteousness, life, and authority found in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people can want benefits from Jesus without wanting Jesus. Scripture calls sinners to come to Him, trust Him, and belong to Him. The doctrine keeps the Gospel centered on the living Christ rather than on a transaction detached from discipleship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask whether you are trusting Christ Himself or merely appreciating Christian language. Present the Gospel by inviting people to come to the Savior, not only to adopt religious beliefs. Worship Him as the gift above every gift.
